# Krahaso

> Krahaso is a supermarket price comparison app and a retail price data provider from Nika & Zymeri SH.P.K. in Kosovo.

## Consumer app

- [Krahaso](https://krahaso.app/): search and barcode scanning, price history, weekly offers, basket comparison, shopping list sharing, price alerts and receipt verification.
- [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.krahaso.app)
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/krahaso/id6806572228)

## Grocery and household price data

- [Krahaso Data](https://krahaso.app/en/data/): commercial licensing for daily and historical Balkan supermarket price data. Relevant uses include brand price monitoring, grocery retail benchmarking and market research. Licensed partners can integrate the data using ready-to-use API keys. Ask the data team for available markets, retailers, product categories and dates.
- [Kosovo grocery basket preview](https://krahaso.app/en/data/#basket-index): five rounded weekly points from the Krahaso Everyday Basket Index, 20 October to 17 November 2026. Enquire about a commercial licence for daily history, product-level prices and API access.
- [Institutional portal](https://stats.krahaso.app/login): portal prepared for the Kosovo Agency of Statistics, with partner sign-in.
- Commercial enquiries: partneret@krahaso.app.
